description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries for the spreadsheet surface floor (road-to-surface-specific-agent-contracts Phase 2). Should-trigger covers building/editing a spreadsheet or model, entering formulas or sourced/financial figures, and charting raw data. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours whose vocabulary overlaps but belong to a different surface/skill: unit-economics reasoning, runway shape, a prose document, a slide deck, and backend work.

queries.q: build a 3-statement financial model in a spreadsheet
add a formula to sum the revenue column and total it
chart this raw sales transaction data
enter the revenue figures from the company's 10-K into the sheet
create a budget spreadsheet with monthly categories
what is our LTV to CAC ratio and is it healthy?
how long is our cash runway?
write a PRD for the new onboarding feature
turn these results into a slide deck
add a database index on the orders table
